title: Boss VG-800 V Guitar Processor

controlChangeCommands.name: Bank Select
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Bank Select MSB (CC0). 150 memories (50 banks × 3) via PROGRAM MAP BANK1–BANK2 and RX PC MAP. CC1-31 and CC64-95 user-assignable via ASSIGN SOURCE; no fixed factory CC map.

additionalInfo: TRS MIDI IN/OUT (Boss BMIDI). SYNC CLOCK AUTO/MIDI/USB to receive clock.
